items.title: Dana White admits he may have made Josh Hokit's UFC rise harder
items.blurb: Dana White says he may have made Josh Hokit ’s path to an Ultimate Fighting Championship heavyweight title shot more difficult because he disliked some of the unbeaten contender’s comments.

items.title: 'He's not here': Josh Hokit calls out Gable Steveson’s Jackson-Wink ties
items.blurb: Josh Hokit questions Gable Steveson ’s training environment.

items.title: Caio Borralho says he hid broken rib from UFC, beat Reinier de Ridder
items.blurb: Caio Borralho says he fought Reinier de Ridder with a broken rib and did not tell the Ultimate Fighting Championship how serious the injury was before their March bout.
